  • Methodendetails

    • postRecipe

      @PostMapping("recipes") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<RecipeDto> postRecipe(@RequestBody RecipeDto recipeDto)
      Endpoint for creating a new recipe.

      This method accepts a recipe object as input, processes it through the recipe service, and returns the created recipe along with an appropriate HTTP status code.

      • Returns 201 Created if the recipe is successfully created.
      • Returns 409 Conflict if the creation process fails (e.g., due to a conflict).
      Parameter:
      recipeDto - the RecipeDto object containing the details of the recipe to be created
      Gibt zurück:
      a ResponseEntity containing the saved recipe and the corresponding HTTP status code

    • getRecipe

      @GetMapping("recipes/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<RecipeDto> getRecipe(@PathVariable("id") long id)
      Endpoint for retrieving a recipe by its ID.

      This method fetches a recipe using the provided ID and returns it in the response body. The recipe is retrieved through the recipe service.

      Parameter:
      id - the ID of the recipe to be retrieved
      Gibt zurück:
      a ResponseEntity containing the RecipeDto with the requested recipe details and an HTTP status of 200 OK

    • putRecipe

      @PutMapping("recipes/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<RecipeDto> putRecipe(@PathVariable("id") long id, @RequestBody RecipeDto recipeDto)
      Endpoint for updating an existing recipe by its ID.

      This method updates the details of a recipe specified by its ID using the data provided in the request body. If the recipe is successfully updated, the updated recipe is returned with an HTTP status of 200 OK. If the recipe with the specified ID is not found, it returns an HTTP status of 404 Not Found.

      Parameter:
      id - the ID of the recipe to be updated
      recipeDto - the RecipeDto object containing the updated recipe details
      Gibt zurück:
      a ResponseEntity containing the updated RecipeDto and the corresponding HTTP status

    • getAllRecipe

      @GetMapping("recipes") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<RecipeDto>> getAllRecipe()
      Endpoint for retrieving all recipes.

      This method fetches all recipes from the database, maps them to RecipeDto objects, and returns them as a list in the response body with an HTTP status of 200 OK.

      Gibt zurück:
      a ResponseEntity containing a list of RecipeDto objects representing all recipes

    • deleteRecipe

      @DeleteMapping("recipes/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> deleteRecipe(@PathVariable("id") long id)
      Endpoint for deleting a recipe by its ID.

      This method deletes the recipe specified by its ID. If the deletion is successful, it returns a success message with an HTTP status of 200 OK.

      Parameter:
      id - the ID of the recipe to be deleted
      Gibt zurück:
      a ResponseEntity containing a success message and the corresponding HTTP status

    • handleFileUpload

      @PostMapping("/upload") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<RecipeDto> handleFileUpload(@RequestParam("image") org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file)
      Endpoint for handling file uploads and processing the uploaded image for OCR.

      This method accepts an image file, saves it to the server, and processes it using OCR to extract recipe details. The extracted details are returned as a RecipeDto. If an error occurs during the OCR process, a response with an HTTP status of 500 Internal Server Error is returned along with an empty RecipeDto.

      Parameter:
      file - the uploaded image file to be processed
      Gibt zurück:
      a ResponseEntity containing the extracted RecipeDto on success, or an empty RecipeDto with an error status in case of failure
